attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: post_publication_file_management

steps:
  - id: move_pdf_to_completed
    op: google_drive/move_file
    params:
      file_id: "{{ trigger.source_pdf_file_id }}"
      source_folder: "{{ trigger.pending_folder_id }}"
      destination_folder: "{{ trigger.completados_folder_id }}"
    output: moved_file

  - id: read_category_spreadsheet
    op: google_sheets/read_spreadsheet
    params:
      spreadsheet_id: "{{ trigger.category_spreadsheet_id }}"
      sheet_name: "{{ trigger.category_sheet_name }}"
    output: spreadsheet_data

  - id: update_article_status
    op: google_sheets/update_row
    params:
      spreadsheet_id: "{{ trigger.category_spreadsheet_id }}"
      sheet_name: "{{ trigger.category_sheet_name }}"
      row_match_column: "article_id"
      row_match_value: "{{ trigger.article_id }}"
      updates:
        status: "published"
        published_date: "{{ now() }}"
        cms_url: "{{ trigger.published_url }}"
    output: updated_row

  - id: write_audit_log
    op: logging/write_audit_entry
    params:
      log_source: post_publication_file_management
      article_id: "{{ trigger.article_id }}"
      timestamp: "{{ now() }}"
      actions_completed:
        - description: "PDF moved to completados folder"
          file_id: "{{ moved_file.id }}"
          source_folder: "{{ trigger.pending_folder_id }}"
          destination_folder: "{{ trigger.completados_folder_id }}"
        - description: "Category spreadsheet updated with published status"
          spreadsheet_id: "{{ trigger.category_spreadsheet_id }}"
          row_updated: "{{ updated_row.row_number }}"
      status: success
    output: audit_entry
